questions.question_english: The concept of Emotional Intelligence was first formally conceptualized in 1990 by which of the following pairs of researchers?
questions.explanation_english: The formal psychological conceptualization of emotional intelligence was introduced in 1990 by researchers Peter Salovey and John Mayer. They defined it as a set of mental abilities involving the perception, integration, understanding, and management of emotions. Their foundational research established emotional intelligence as an empirical scientific domain, separate from traditional cognitive intelligence measures.
